verse.verse_3: And what will make you know what Al-Haqqah is
verse.verse_5: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the Taghiyah!
verse.verse_6: And as for `Ad, they were destroyed by a wind, Sarsar `Atiyah!
verse.verse_7: Which Allah imposed on them for seven nights and eight days Husum, so that you could see men lying toppled, as if they were trunks of date palms, Khawiyah!
verse.verse_8: Do you see any remnants of them
verse.verse_9: And Fir`awn, and those before him, and the cities overthrown committed Al-Khati'ah.
verse.verse_10: And they disobeyed their Lord's Messenger, so He seized them with a punishment that was Rabiyah.
verse.verse_11: Verily, when the water rose beyond its limits, We carried you in the ship.
verse.verse_12: That We might make it an admonition for you and that it might be retained by the retaining ears.
verse.verse_13: Then when the Trumpet will be blown with one blowing.
verse.verse_14: And the earth and the mountains shall be removed from their places, and crushed with a single crushing.
verse.verse_15: Then on that Day shall the Event occur.
verse.verse_16: And the heaven will be rent asunder, for that Day it will be frail and torn up.
verse.verse_17: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight angels will, that Day, bear the Throne of your Lord above them.
verse.verse_18: That Day shall you be brought to Judgement, not a secret of you will be hidden.
verse.verse_19: Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Here! read my Record!"
verse.verse_20: "Surely, I did believe that I shall meet my account!"
verse.verse_21: So, he shall be in a life, well-pleasing.
verse.verse_23: The fruits in bunches whereof will be low and near at hand.
verse.verse_24: Eat and drink at ease for that which you have sent on before you in days past!
verse.verse_25: But as for him who will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "I wish that I had not been given my Record!"
verse.verse_26: "And that I had never known how my account is!"
verse.verse_27: "Would that it had been my end!"
verse.verse_30: (It will be said): "Seize him and fetter him;"
verse.verse_31: "Then throw him in the blazing Fire."
verse.verse_32: "Then fasten him on a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits!"
verse.verse_33: Verily, he used not to believe in Allah, the Most Great,
verse.verse_34: And urged not the feeding of the poor.
verse.verse_35: So, no friend has he here this Day,
verse.verse_36: Nor any food except filth from Ghislin.
verse.verse_37: None will eat it except the Khati'un.
verse.verse_38: So, I swear by whatsoever you see,
verse.verse_39: And by whatsoever you see not,
verse.verse_40: That this is verily the word of an honored Messenger.
verse.verse_41: It is not the word of a poet, little is that you believe!
verse.verse_42: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer, little is that you remember!
verse.verse_43: This is the revelation sent down from the Lord of all that exists.
verse.verse_44: And if he had forged a false saying concerning Us,
verse.verse_45: We surely would have seized him by his right hand,
verse.verse_46: And then We certainly would have cut off Al-Watin from him,
verse.verse_47: And none of you could have prevented it from him.
verse.verse_48: And verily, this is a Reminder for those who have Taqwa.
verse.verse_49: And verily, We know that there are some among you that deny.
verse.verse_50: And indeed it will be an anguish for the disbelievers.
verse.verse_51: And verily, it (this Qur'an) is an absolute truth with certainty.
verse.verse_52: So, glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.
